notes.title: PRE-RELEASE DEVELOPMENT ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We are excited to announce that we are in the mid-late stages of the development. Soon expect new screesnhots, new store page art and a new trailer coming up.[/p][p]If you're interested in the game, [b]please consider adding it to your Wishlist[/b]. Your support means a lot to us. The game is inspired by Chained Together and Only Up!. Feel free to drop any ideas and suggestions in the Community hub.[/p]
